form.label: Veeam Backup & Replication - Overview
form.description: Fixture-backed onboarding and first-triage dashboard for Veeam Backup & Replication syslog job/activity records. This is not replay/read-back validation.

search.query: index=infraops sourcetype="veeam:vbr:syslog" host=$host_tok$ (user="$user_tok$" OR "$user_tok$"="*") | stats count
index=infraops sourcetype="veeam:vbr:syslog" host=$host_tok$ (user="$user_tok$" OR "$user_tok$"="*") (result=Success OR signature="*completed successfully*" OR action="*Success*") | stats count
index=infraops sourcetype="veeam:vbr:syslog" host=$host_tok$ (user="$user_tok$" OR "$user_tok$"="*") | stats dc(session_id) as sessions
index=infraops sourcetype="veeam:vbr:syslog" host=$host_tok$ (user="$user_tok$" OR "$user_tok$"="*") | stats dc(object) as objects
index=infraops sourcetype="veeam:vbr:syslog" host=$host_tok$ (user="$user_tok$" OR "$user_tok$"="*") | timechart count

index=infraops sourcetype="veeam:vbr:syslog" host=$host_tok$ (user="$user_tok$" OR "$user_tok$"="*") | eval action_result=coalesce(action,result,signature) | stats count by action_result | sort -count | head 20

index=infraops sourcetype="veeam:vbr:syslog" host=$host_tok$ (user="$user_tok$" OR "$user_tok$"="*") | table _time host source action result session_id signature signature_id object src_host user marker | sort -_time | head 100

index=infraops sourcetype="veeam:vbr:syslog" host=$host_tok$ (user="$user_tok$" OR "$user_tok$"="*") | table _time host values.categoryId values.instanceId values.JobSessionID values.TaskSessionID values.Status values.ActivityType values.SourceHostName values.ObjectName marker | sort -_time | head 100

panel.title: Top users, source hosts, and objects

search.query: index=infraops sourcetype="veeam:vbr:syslog" host=$host_tok$ (user="$user_tok$" OR "$user_tok$"="*") | stats count, values(action) as actions, values(result) as results, values(signature_id) as instance_ids by user, src_host, object | sort -count | head 50

index=infraops sourcetype="veeam:vbr:syslog" host=$host_tok$ (user="$user_tok$" OR "$user_tok$"="*") | stats count, dc(session_id) as session_count, dc(user) as user_count, values(vendor_product) as vendor_product by host, source, sourcetype | sort -count | head 100

index=infraops sourcetype="veeam:vbr:syslog" host=$host_tok$ (user="$user_tok$" OR "$user_tok$"="*") | table _time host source sourcetype vendor product action result session_id signature signature_id object src_host user marker _raw | sort -_time | head 100
